rules.statement: The failure of the Fiscal to demand payment under section 226 of the Code does not render the seizure and sale a nullity, nor is it grounds for a separate action.
rules.supporting_quote: "On a consideration of all these authorities, I am of opinion that the fact that no demand was made by the Fiscal under section 226 of the Code does not deprive the Court of jurisdiction and render the seizure and sale thereafter a nullity, and that it is not open to any person to seek to attack the seizure and sale on that ground in a separate action."
